title: Casting an object to object preserves its identity

ground_truth.statement: Casting an existing object to object returns the same object without changing its identity or state. The cast is redundant, though legal. This case measures a redundant-operation diagnostic policy, not a runtime bug.

provenance.derivation: Direct object parameter isolates identity-preserving cast.

notes: Psalm and Mago report the redundant cast. PHPStan is silent, retained as a policy-comparison FN. Missing a redundancy diagnostic does not imply the legal cast should be forbidden.
